[nation]Alkiragunya[/nation]

Harold throws down a handful of red sand in frustration. [i]"We have been at this for days... Are you sure there are diamonds here at all, Brent?"[/i]

[i]"No. But we can't turn up empty-handed, the bosses aren't going to like it."[/i]

[i]"F*ck what the bosses at BMG think, Brent! We've been out here in this goddamn desert for days, Jared has almost died from heatstroke four times and our rations are not enough! I want to go home, mate!"[/i]

[i]"We're not going home until we find..."[/i]

Brent stops. He slowly lifts a chunk of sand up.

There's a small, translucent stone of some kind inside the red sand. It has a yellowish hue, with a few streaks of black and darker patches of amber.

[i]"Well I'll be f*cked. Harold, come here!"[/i]

Harold stumbles over. [i]"What is it... oh my God."[/i]

Brent utters a few words. [i]"Are you thinking what I'm thinking, mate?"[/i]

[i]"Yeah. That's a bloody diamond. It can't be anything else."[/i]

[i]"The bosses are gonna love this."[/i]

[sub]The view slowly pans up to the deep blue sky above the desert as a song begins to play: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZwbEuzJCnqI[/sub]
